justification: Image A depicts a single composite anthropomorphic figure with feathered/winged elements, elaborate headdress, and held objects rendered in a naturalistic, sculptural style, while Image B depicts multiple small schematic figures, boat forms, a grid/ladder pattern, and vertical lines in a flat linear engraving style. There is no shared depicted subject matter, motif, or compositional relationship between the two; the closest thing to overlap (both include human-like forms) is too generic and differently rendered to count as a meaningful iconographic correspondence.
